title: Issuer-host access measured from this environment — five hosts unreachable, TLS aborted before any HTTP status

control.reading: The control host answered 200 in the same shell, so the five failures are not a broken curl invocation or a missing CA bundle; they are the sandbox allowlist refusing the connection before HTTP exists.

reading: A failure to reach a host is not a statement about the filing. Every row here records a retrieval that did not happen, in the closed vocabulary the verifier enforces (NO_ROUTE). No document in this bundle receives a status other than that, and no quotation is drawn from any of them.
notClaimed: that the reports are unavailable to the issuer
that the filings carry no disclosure
that the exchange archive has no route for any environment
